items.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
items.snippet: Mass Spec Skills empowers scientists using Google Antigravity to interpret tandem mass spectra.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.snippet: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

items.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
items.snippet: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

items.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
items.snippet: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

items.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.snippet: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.snippet: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.snippet: Using agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.snippet: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.snippet: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.snippet: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.snippet: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.snippet: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.snippet: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

items.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.snippet: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.
